title: Muscat sit-in supporting Gaza, reported 16 October 2024
reason: The opened report establishes an actual public sit-in and describes hundreds, but its stated demands condemn Israeli/US actions and support Gaza/resistance; it does not document a demand on Oman’s state or policy. Excluded from own-country state-target protest scope.
notes: One-source report by a Yemeni outlet; exact turnout and independent corroboration remain unknown. This is an exclusion for target scope, not a finding that the action did not occur.

actual_occurrence.summary: Article states that Muscat residents conducted a protest sit-in on 2024-10-16.

location.summary: Dateline says Muscat; article describes residents of the Omani capital.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Reported hundreds in a single sit-in, supporting a group above 50; exact count not reported.

demand_target.summary: Condemnation of Israeli/US aggression against Gaza and support for Palestinian resistance; no demand on the Omani government is stated.
